note: Both sets capture the same core drivetrain values with supporting table quotes, but Set A repeats the rated rotor speed three times (two redundant/trivial claims) and binds the brake time constant to the high-speed shaft rather than the brake. Set B keeps the fully-deployed condition on the brake torque and has only one redundant rotor claim, while still covering all nine table properties. Set B is thus slightly cleaner and more faithful, with no invented values in either set.
